entities.name: Baird
entities.description: A soldier and one of the stewards of New Argive, a skilled combatant and keen scholar.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: A land on Terisiare near the Yavimaya forest that remembers the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance Baird swore allegiance to in his homeland's darkest hour.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The devastation New Argive keenly remembers from three and a half centuries ago.

events.summary: Baird swore allegiance to the Coalition in New Argive's darkest hour.
events.quote: In his homeland's darkest hour, Baird swore allegiance to the Coalition .

events.summary: Baird was among the first to call for investigations into a Phyrexian menace.
events.quote: He was among the first to call for investigations into the possibility of the Phyrexian menace.

relations.quote: Baird swore allegiance to the Coalition .
Baird was one of New Argive's stewards charged with keeping watch over threats to the nation.
